source_player_text: Я не желаю им смерти и мы в команде. Всё
continuity: Shiki responds to Kabuto that his concern for Aki and Ren is simply that they are teammates and he does not wish them dead; he refuses to elaborate. Kabuto accepts boundary and does not make the player repeat answer; refuses to assert unproven espionage, promises only his own behavior, private conversation ends without new blood sample, confession, access, or contract. Aki's imaging proceeds; Ren stays with her. Shiki remains free to choose his next action.
status: Player-visible future scene drafted as narrative continuity, not engine-confirmed.
